insights.one_liner: Follo is a tiny construction-logistics software startup that helps building sites coordinate deliveries and crane time, with two open roles in Groningen.

culture.text: A very small team: LinkedIn lists 5 employees and a 2-10 size range; the company was founded in 2020.
It builds an app for contractors to plan deliveries, crane picks and inspections, and track carbon emissions on site.
Says its team has diverse life, professional and geographical backgrounds.
Its 2 open jobs here are both in Groningen: one in data and one in marketing.

open.text: Follo is not an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings need no Dutch; one shows pay.
Its LinkedIn headquarters is in Murrieta, California, so the Groningen roles are part of a US-based company.
